The root cause of the error is that the `revenue_numeric` column was not successfully created due to a silent failure in the `astype(float)` conversion — likely because some values in `revenue` contain non-numeric characters or are malformed, even though the data dictionary says they are numeric with thousands separators.

We must inspect the `revenue` column more carefully to identify and handle any invalid values before converting.

# Load the data
